_doc: Cave generator settings (ADR-0056, docs/CAVES_PLAN.md). Read by CavePlan.build / CaveSites through the config dictionary passed in (the planner never reads Content itself). Lengths, radii and distances are metres; angles are degrees. A style's ranges are [min, max] picked by the cave's seed. Changing a shape number changes every cave: bump CavePlan.GEN_VERSION with it.

warp._doc: Seeded 3D lattice (cell metres, cells per side, amplitude metres) warping the capsule distance; precomputed per plan.
